name: air65-bounded-web-v2
description: Geometry-aware sampling with per-object sampled deviation gates; no global decimation ratio.
notes: Independent visual review found focal lens-ring faceting despite passing distance gates. Preserve the complete camera geometry in the final profile.
Radial samples are chosen as divisors of original angular counts with cardinal directions retained.
All primitive resampling selects original authored vertices rather than inventing a new shape.
Textured mesh primitives retain their authored tessellation so that texture UVs remain unchanged.
Planar dissolve protects sharp, material, UV, normal and open boundaries.
Failed candidates revert to the complete source evaluated mesh.
Deviation is a deterministic two-way vertex/triangle-centroid sample, not a certified continuous Hausdorff bound.
